sn35.243:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn35.243:1.2: tena kho pana samayena kapilavatthuvāsīnaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ saṇṭhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
sn35.243:1.3: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn35.243:1.4: idha bhante kapilavatthuvāsīnaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ saṇṭhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
sn35.243:1.6: bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā kāpilavatthavā sakyā paribhuñjissanti
sn35.243:1.7: tadassa kapilavatthuvāsīnaṃ sakyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn35.243:2.1: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena navaṃ saṇṭhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā sabbasantharisanthataṃ saṇṭhāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn35.243:2.2: sabbasantharisanthataṃ bhante saṇṭhāgāraṃ āsanāni paññattāni udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito telappadīpo āropito
sn35.243:2.4: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena navaṃ saṇṭhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā saṇṭhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
sn35.243:2.5: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā saṇṭhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
sn35.243:2.6: kāpilavatthavāpi sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā saṇṭhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchāmukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
sn35.243:2.7: atha kho bhagavā kāpilavatthave sakye bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi
sn35.243:2.10: evaṃ bhanteti kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
sn35.243:3.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu kāpilavatthavesu sakyesu āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi
sn35.243:3.3: paṭibhātu taṃ moggallāna bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā
sn35.243:3.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paccassosi.
sn35.243:3.7: atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññapettavā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā
sn35.243:3.8: tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi
sn35.243:3.10: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
sn35.243:3.13: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti.
sn35.243:3.14: evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ
sn35.243:4.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.243:4.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti …pe…
sn35.243:4.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme byāpajjati anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso
sn35.243:4.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.243:4.7: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu avassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu …pe…
sn35.243:4.10: evaṃvihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati labhateva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:4.12: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati labhateva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.1: seyyathāpi āvuso naḷāgāraṃ vā tiṇāgāraṃ vā sukkhakāḷāsaṃ terovassikaṃ
sn35.243:5.2: puratthimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.3: pacchimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya …pe…
sn35.243:5.8: yato kuto cepi naṃ puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya labhetheva aggi otāraṃ labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.9: evameva kho āvuso evaṃvihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati labhetheva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:5.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati labhetheva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.12: evaṃvihāriñcāvuso bhikkhuṃ rūpā adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi
sn35.243:5.13: saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu sadde adhibhosi
sn35.243:5.14: gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu gandhe adhibhosi
sn35.243:5.15: rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu rase adhibhosi
sn35.243:5.16: phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu phoṭṭhabbe adhibhosi
sn35.243:5.17: dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu na bhikkhu dhamme adhibhosi.
sn35.243:5.18: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rūpādhibhūto saddādhibhūto gandhādhikūto rasādhibhūto phoṭṭhabbādhibhūto dhammādhibhūto anadhibhūto adhibhaṃsu pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiyā.
sn35.243:6.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.243:6.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti …pe…
sn35.243:6.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati appiyarūpe dhamme na byāpajjati upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso
sn35.243:6.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññavimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti. yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.243:6.7: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu anavassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu …pe… ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu anavassuto jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu …pe…
sn35.243:6.9: evaṃvihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati māro otāraṃ na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:6.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati māro otāraṃ na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.2: puratthimāya cepi disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:7.8: yato kutoci ce puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.9: evameva kho āvuso evaṃvihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati na labhateva māro otāraṃ na labhate māro ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:7.10: jivhāto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati na labheteva māro otāraṃ na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.11: evaṃvihārī cāvuso bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi na rūpā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu
sn35.243:7.12: sadde bhikkhu adhibhosi na saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu
sn35.243:7.13: gandhe bhikkhu adhibhosi na gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu
sn35.243:7.14: rase bhikkhu adhibhosi na rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu
sn35.243:7.15: phoṭṭhabbe bhikkhu adhibhosi na phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu
sn35.243:7.16: dhamme bhikkhu adhibhosi na dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu.
sn35.243:7.17: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rūpādhibhū saddādhibhū gandhādhibhū rasādhibhū phoṭṭhabbādhibhū dhammādhibhū adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṅkilesike ponobbhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇiye.
sn35.243:8.1: atha kho bhagavā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi
sn35.243:8.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ moggallāna bhikkhūnaṃ avassutapariyāyañca anavassutapariyāyañca abhāsīti.
sn35.243:9.3: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
